definitions.explanation: A self-governing administrative body at the regional or local level. In Japan, this includes prefectures (都道府県) and municipalities (市町村). Frequently encountered in news and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {自治体|じちたい}が{補助金|ほじょきん}を{出|だ}す。
examples.english: The local government provides a subsidy.

examples.japanese: {各|かく}{自治体|じちたい}がゴミの{分別|ぶんべつ}ルールを{定|さだ}めている。
examples.english: Each municipality sets its own rules for garbage separation.

examples.japanese: {少子化|しょうしか}{対策|たいさく}として、{多|おお}くの{自治体|じちたい}が{子育|こそだ}て{支援|しえん}を{充実|じゅうじつ}させている。
examples.english: As a countermeasure to the declining birth rate, many municipalities are enhancing their childcare support.

notes:
USAGE:
{自治体|じちたい} is a common word in news, politics, and daily life. Japan's local government system has two layers: {都道府県|とどうふけん} (prefectures) and {市町村|しちょうそん} (cities, towns, and villages). {自治体|じちたい} can refer to either level. The formal legal term is {地方公共団体|ちほうこうきょうだんたい}, but {自治体|じちたい} is the everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地方|ちほう}{自治体|じちたい}: local government
- {各|かく}{自治体|じちたい}: each municipality
- {自治体|じちたい}の{取|と}り{組|く}み: municipal initiatives
- {自治体|じちたい}{職員|しょくいん}: municipal employee
